summary: Comprehensive testing of BYE logic for knockout tournaments with odd numbers of section winners. All backend tests passed (11/11). Frontend displays 'Advances Automatically' banner correctly with BYE participant badges.
passed_tests: Backend: BYE logic with 5 section winners - creates 3 BYEs and 1 match (Diana vs Eve)
Backend: BYE logic with 3 section winners - creates 1 BYE and 1 match
Backend: BYE logic with 4 section winners (even) - creates 0 BYEs and 2 matches
Backend: BYE logic with 7 section winners - creates 1 BYE and 3 matches
Backend: /api/championships/{id}/bye-participants returns correct data with 'Advances automatically' status
Backend: advance_knockout_round correctly carries BYE participants forward to next round
Backend: BYE selection based on best round-robin performance (points, shot diff, shots for)
Backend: BYE endpoint requires authentication (returns 401 without token)
Backend: BYE endpoint returns empty list before knockout stage
Backend: Public bracket returns 404 for invalid championship ID
Frontend: 'Advances Automatically' banner displays in Bracket tab
Frontend: BYE participant badges (Alice, Bob, Carol) shown in blue styling
Frontend: Toast message shows '3 advance automatically: Alice, Bob, Carol'
Frontend: Single knockout match (Diana vs Eve) displayed correctly
Frontend: Knockout Quarter badge shown in header after generation
critical_code_review_comments: BYE logic correctly calculates bracket size as next power of 2
BYE participants are properly sorted by knockout_seed (based on section order)
advance_knockout_round properly retrieves and includes BYE participants from previous round
Frontend KnockoutBracket component correctly renders byeParticipants prop with FastForward icon
test_credentials: Multiple test users created with pattern: test_bye_*@test.com, bye_test_*@test.com, bye_full_*@test.com
seed_data_creation: Test championships created with 3, 4, 5, and 7 sections to verify BYE logic across different scenarios
context_for_next_testing_agent: BYE logic for knockout tournaments is fully implemented and tested. Key test file: /app/tests/test_bye_logic.py covers all scenarios (3, 4, 5, 7 section winners). The frontend displays 'Advances Automatically' banner with participant badges in the Bracket tab. Backend endpoints /api/championships/{id}/bye-participants and /api/public/championships/{id}/bracket both return bye_participants correctly.
